source.publisher: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare, Japan
source.table: General workers, Table 1, detailed occupation and sex, all industries

methodology.annualisation: (monthly regular cash earnings * 12 + annual bonuses and other special cash earnings) * 1000
methodology.population: Japan, general workers, both sexes, enterprises with at least 10 employees, all industries in the survey
methodology.cashPeriod: June 2025 regular cash earnings, including overtime cash payments, before deductions
methodology.bonusPeriod: Generally January to December 2024; the survey specifies adjusted reference periods for employees hired during that year
methodology.definition: Annualised survey cash earnings including bonuses; not an observed calendar-year total, median, base salary or total employer cost
methodology.rounding: Underlying components are published to 0.1 thousand JPY. Job tag displays the derived result rounded to 0.1 ten-thousand JPY. Keep the component-derived value separate.

licence.terms: MHLW public data use terms PDL 1.0, subject to separately marked content
licence.attribution: Source: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare, Basic Survey on Wage Structure 2025, general workers Table 1, accessed 2026-10-31. Annualised cash earnings calculated from published components.
licence.jobTagAttribution: Occupation crosswalk and rounded comparison: job tag, Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare. Duty descriptions are concise application-authored paraphrases; no JILPT descriptive text or assessment material is reproduced.
